name: Quicksilver CI: server harness
description: CI only (phase 2, P2-0), loaded in every server-suite run, vanilla and Quicksilver alike, never in a release: pins the server's unseeded random numbers so runs repeat, generates chunks one at a time in a fixed order, plays a scripted run of a fixed number of ticks after the whole area has loaded, measures milliseconds per tick, and carries the GameTest suite.
